Chemistry.q: Identify the incorrect statement related to PCl5 from the following:
options: Three equatorial P-Cl bonds make an angle of 120° with each other
Two axial P-Cl bonds make an angle of 180° with each other
Axial P-Cl bonds are longer than equatorial P-Cl bonds
Chemistry.hint: PCl5 is highly reactive. The axial bonds are longer and weaker than equatorial bonds, making it reactive.

Botany.q: Which of the following algae contains mannitol as reserve food material?
Botany.hint: Mannitol is the reserve food material in brown algae (Phaeophyceae). Ectocarpus is a brown alga.

Zoology.q: Which of the following is not an objective of Biofortification in crops?
Zoology.hint: Biofortification aims to improve the nutritional quality of crops, not necessarily their disease resistance (which is a different breeding objective).
